an4.127:1.1: tathāgatassa bhikkhave arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvā cattāro acchariyā abbhutadhammā pātubhavanti
an4.127:1.3: yadā bhikkhave bodhisatto tusitā kāyā cavitvā sato sampajāno mātu kucchiṃ okkamati atha sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya appamāṇo uḷāro obhāso pātubhavati atikkammeva devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ
an4.127:1.4: yāpi tā lokantarikā aghā asaṃvutā andhakārā andhakāratimisā yatthimesaṃ candimasuriyānaṃ evaṃmahiddhikānaṃ evaṃmahānubhāvānaṃ ābhā nānubhonti tatthapi appamāṇo uḷāro obhāso pātubhavati atikkammeva devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ
an4.127:1.5: yepi tattha sattā upapannā tepi tenobhāsena aññamaññaṃ sañjānanti
an4.127:1.6: aññepi kira bho santi sattā idhupapannāti
an4.127:1.7: tathāgatassa bhikkhave arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvā ayaṃ paṭhamo acchariyo abbhutadhammo pātubhavati.
an4.127:2.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave yadā bodhisatto sato sampajāno mātu kucchismā nikkhamati …pe…
an4.127:2.5: tathāgatassa bhikkhave arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvā ayaṃ dutiyo acchariyo abbhutadhammo pātubhavati.
an4.127:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave yadā tathāgato anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambujjhati …pe…
an4.127:3.5: tathāgatassa bhikkhave arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvā ayaṃ tatiyo acchariyo abbhutadhammo pātubhavati.
an4.127:4.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave yadā tathāgato anuttaraṃ dhammacakkaṃ pavatteti atha sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya appamāṇo uḷāro obhāso pātubhavati atikkammeva devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ
an4.127:4.2: yāpi tā lokantarikā aghā asaṃvutā andhakārā andhakāratimisā yatthimesaṃ candimasuriyānaṃ evaṃmahiddhikānaṃ evaṃmahānubhāvānaṃ ābhā nānubhonti tatthapi appamāṇo uḷāro obhāso pātubhavati atikkammeva devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ
an4.127:4.3: yepi tattha sattā upapannā tepi tenobhāsena aññamaññaṃ sañjānanti
an4.127:4.4: aññepi kira bho santi sattā idhupapannāti
an4.127:4.5: tathāgatassa bhikkhave arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvā ayaṃ catuttho acchariyo abbhutadhammo pātubhavati.
an4.127:4.6: tathāgatassa bhikkhave arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvā ime cattāro acchariyā abbhutadhammā pātubhavantīti.
